message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Li, a financial audit department head, was responsible for auditing grain stations. He discovered that station head Huang had embezzled public funds (240+ million) for personal use. Li, instead of reporting, only privately reminded Huang, and failed to point out in meeting or report to leadership. This is a serious dereliction of duty. The charge likely is "滥用职权" (abuse of power) or "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" (failure to transfer criminal case). However the list includes "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" which is used for officials who fail to transfer criminal cases. Here Li didn't report the crime, which is similar. Also "滥用职权" is for abusing authority. He didn't abuse authority to benefit himself, just failed to act. The appropriate charge is "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". In previous examples, similar scenario: a health inspector failing to transfer illegal medical cases was charged "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件". So we choose that.

Thus answer: [罪名]徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件<eoa>

Check list: "徇私舞弊不移交刑事案件" exactly present. Yes.
